init.description: Create a database in a new directory. Parent directory must exist. Schema and preset are mutually exclusive.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

schema.description: JSON file containing an array of {name,type}; first field timestamp:i64

append.description: Append one JSON object or an array. Validate all records and ordering before writing, then flush and fsync.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

input.description: JSON file, or - for stdin. Maximum 16 MiB.

info.description: Read schema, timestamp unit, storage format and committed record count.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

query.description: Return all records in [start,end). Fail if more than limit match; never silently truncate.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

start.description: Inclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 minimum

end.description: Exclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 maximum

stats.description: Read min/max/sum/count/mean for a numeric field. Percentiles are not computed.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

start.description: Inclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 minimum

end.description: Exclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 maximum

field.description: Default close, falling back to price

snapshot.description: Read latest indicator snapshot. Warm-up/unavailable values are null. Price role is close or price.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

bucket.description: OHLCV bucket width in stored timestamp units; 0 uses raw records

periods_per_year.description: Annualization frequency; 0 uses engine inference. Set explicitly for comparable risk statistics.

health.description: Read gaps and price/volume quality; log returns above 0.1 count as outliers.

db.description: Explicit database directory containing hocdb.json and series.bin

start.description: Inclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 minimum

end.description: Exclusive timestamp in stored units; defaults to i64 maximum

gap_threshold.description: Gap threshold in stored timestamp units

--version.description: Return version and storage/CLI contract versions.

io.help: Plain text; no arguments, --help, help, or COMMAND --help

data_contract.strings: UTF-8, at most 128 bytes; no NUL bytes
data_contract.integers: i64/u64 accept JSON integers or decimal strings. Output outside -(2^53-1)..2^53-1 is a decimal string.
data_contract.timestamps: Strictly increasing Unix timestamps from 0; maximum accepted is 9223372036854775806. Unit stored in hocdb.json.
data_contract.nulls: Missing/undefined analytics values are null, never a trading signal.
data_contract.capacity: 2 GiB per database, no automatic overwrite
data_contract.concurrency: One writer per database; read commands use lock-free readers
data_contract.durability: Append flushes and fsyncs before success. Validation errors write no input records; storage/I/O failures may partially append. Inspect info/query before retrying.
data_contract.compatibility: CLI opens directories it created. Existing library databases continue to use their language binding and explicit schema.
